stories.title: Man released after fatal crash as inquiries continue
stories.summary: A man was pronounced dead after a car crashed into a parked vehicle in Leicester.

stories.title: Overnight resurfacing to shut A6 in £1.9m upgrade
stories.summary: The A6, between Asda and New Street in Oadby, will shut overnight during weekdays until 27 November.

stories.title: Electric ambulances to be rolled out in East Midlands
stories.summary: East Midlands Ambulance Service says it will begin phasing in the new vehicles in early 2027.

stories.title: Teddy bears help ease foster care goodbyes
stories.summary: An 11-year-old swaps teddies with foster children to help them stay connected after they leave.

stories.title: Arrest as man killed in crash with parked vehicle
stories.summary: Police say the man sustained serious injuries and was pronounced dead at the scene.

stories.title: Guide to Remembrance services across county
stories.summary: Thousands of people, including veterans and current servicemen and women, will be attending events.

stories.title: Concerns over plans for 24-hour adult gaming centre
stories.summary: A planning application has been lodged for an adult gaming centre in Evington Road.

stories.title: Driver arrested after motorcyclist dies in crash
stories.summary: Police say a 43-year-old man was detained on suspicion of causing death by careless driving.

stories.title: Men in balaclavas damage vehicles with baseball bat
stories.summary: Leicestershire Police say homophobic abuse was also shouted during the incident.

stories.title: Man jailed for raping teenage girls in the 1990s
stories.summary: David Campbell, 64, abused the girls between 1992 and 1997 while living in south Leicester.

stories.title: Roof severely damaged after stray firework hits house
stories.summary: A fire service spokesperson says the incident "could have been a lot worse".

stories.title: Dog seized after village attack concerns
stories.summary: Police say the dog had caused "significant concern" locally, with reports it had attacked other dogs.
